questions.text: What is the main advantage of using Specs before implementing a feature?

options.label: Ensures alignment between requirements, design, and implementation before writing code
Allows skipping the design phase since requirements contain all technical details
Eliminates the need for automated tests because the Spec already validates all behavior
Guarantees that the implementation won't need code review

questions.explanation: Using Specs before implementing ensures that requirements, design, and tasks are aligned, reducing rework and guaranteeing that implementation meets actual needs.

questions.text: When using Run all in a Spec, Kiro ignores dependencies and starts every task simultaneously.
questions.explanation: False. Run all analyzes the dependency graph, runs independent tasks in parallel, and waits for prerequisites before dependent tasks. Users can also choose to execute tasks individually.

questions.text: Arrange the complete bugfix workflow with Kiro in the correct order:

options.label: Document current, expected, and unchanged behavior in bugfix.md
Explore the codebase and generate design.md with root cause, fix, and properties
Generate tasks.md with tasks and tests for the fix and regressions
Execute the tasks to implement and validate the fix

questions.explanation: The documented flow starts with behavior analysis in bugfix.md, continues with investigation and design, generates the plan in tasks.md, and only then executes the implementation and validation.
